purpose: Machine-readable reference for ArduPilot Plane SITL sensor fault-injection parameters used by AI agents and experiment scaffolding.

primary: Runtime MAVProxy/SITL parameter output: param show SIM_* / mav.parm
source_of_truth.warning: Narrative SITL documentation can contain stale examples. Prefer runtime param show output, generated parameter files, and current source names.

agent_usage_rules: Do not invent SIM_ parameter names from older examples.
Before running a campaign, verify every parameter against the SITL build under test using param show SIM_* or a saved mav.parm.
Vector entries listed as X/Y/Z expand to three runtime parameters with _X, _Y, and _Z suffixes.
For GPS1 denial, set SIM_GPS1_ENABLE to 0. Do not use SIM_GPS_DISABLE.
For GPS1 position glitch, use SIM_GPS1_GLTCH_X, SIM_GPS1_GLTCH_Y, and SIM_GPS1_GLTCH_Z. The spelling is GLTCH, not GLITCH.
For first accelerometer forced failure value, use SIM_ACCEL1_FAIL. Do not use SIM_ACC1_FAIL.
For gyro update stoppage, use SIM_GYR_FAIL_MSK. There is no current SIM_GYR1_FAIL parameter.
For magnetometer noise, use global SIM_MAG_RND. Do not use SIM_MAG1_RND.

parameters.effect: Stops gyro reading updates for selected simulated IMU instances.
parameters.notes: Use 1 to stop gyro updates for the first IMU instance.

parameters.effect: Adds constant angular-rate bias to the first simulated gyroscope.
parameters.notes: Apply only the axes needed by the case.

parameters.effect: Scales simulated motor vibration noise injected into gyroscope readings.
parameters.notes: Useful for vibration stress tests.

parameters.effect: Applies per-axis multiplicative scale error to the first simulated gyroscope.
parameters.notes: 0 means no scale error.

parameters.effect: When non-zero, forces first simulated accelerometer output to this value on all axes.
parameters.notes: Current parameter name is SIM_ACCEL1_FAIL, not SIM_ACC1_FAIL.

parameters.effect: Stops accelerometer reading updates for selected simulated IMU instances.
parameters.notes: Use 1 to stop accelerometer updates for the first IMU instance.

parameters.effect: Adds constant bias offset to the first simulated accelerometer.
parameters.notes: Apply only the axes needed by the case.

parameters.effect: Scales simulated vibration noise on accelerometer readings.
parameters.notes: Useful for vibration stress tests.

parameters.effect: Applies per-axis multiplicative scale error to the first simulated accelerometer.
parameters.notes: 0 means no scale error.

parameters.effect: Simulates failure of the first magnetometer.
parameters.notes: SITL source comments define 1 as no data.

parameters.effect: Adds hard-iron offset to each magnetometer axis.
parameters.notes: Current runtime defaults may already be non-zero in mav.parm.

parameters.effect: Scales simulated vibration or motor-induced noise in magnetometer readings.
parameters.notes: This is global, not per-compass. SIM_MAG1_RND does not exist.

parameters.effect: Applies scale-factor error to the first simulated compass.
parameters.notes: 1 means nominal scale.

parameters.effect: Marks the primary simulated airspeed sensor as failed.
parameters.notes: Pair with log assertions for airspeed health and TECS response.

parameters.effect: Sets simulated pressure value used by the airspeed failure path.
parameters.notes: Use for fixed erroneous pressure cases.

parameters.effect: Sets simulated pitot tube failure pressure.
parameters.notes: Use for blocked or damaged pitot tests.

parameters.effect: Adds offset to the simulated airspeed sensor reading.
parameters.notes: Default in current source/runtime is 2013.

parameters.effect: Adds random noise to the simulated airspeed sensor.
parameters.notes: Default in current source/runtime is 2.0.

parameters.effect: Applies simulated airspeed sensor ratio calibration mismatch.
parameters.notes: Default in current source/runtime is 1.99.

parameters.effect: Simulates reversed pitot/static connections.
parameters.notes: Use as a severe airspeed plumbing fault.

parameters.effect: Enables or disables first simulated GPS.
parameters.notes: Set to 0 for primary GPS denial.

parameters.effect: Injects position glitch offsets into first simulated GPS.
parameters.notes: Runtime spelling is GLTCH.

parameters.value_range: 0 disabled, 1 HDT, 2 THS, 3 KSXT, 4 moving-baseline base
parameters.effect: Enables simulated GPS heading output.
parameters.notes: Mostly relevant for GPS-for-yaw tests.

parameters.effect: Sets visible satellite count reported by first simulated GPS.
parameters.notes: Low values can degrade quality or trigger checks/failsafes.

parameters.effect: Adds fixed GPS measurement delay.
parameters.notes: Use for EKF delay compensation tests.

parameters.value_range: 0 None, 1 UBlox, 5 NMEA, 6 SBP, 7 File, 8 Nova, 9 SBP2, 11 Trimble, 19 MSP
parameters.effect: Selects simulated GPS backend/protocol.
parameters.notes: Changing GPS type may require reboot depending on test setup.

parameters.effect: Adds simulated GPS altitude error amplitude.
parameters.notes: Source description is altitude error amplitude.

parameters.effect: Adds NED velocity error offsets to first simulated GPS.
parameters.notes: Use per-axis parameters.

parameters.effect: Enables simulated GPS jamming for first GPS.
parameters.notes: Pair with GPS health and failsafe assertions.

parameters.effect: Sets probability that any single rangefinder reading is a random erroneous value.
parameters.notes: Rangefinder impact on Plane depends on configured altitude source and mission phase.

parameters.effect: Adds random noise to rangefinder distance measurements.
parameters.notes: Uses legacy SONAR naming for simulated rangefinder.

parameters.effect: Sets analog rangefinder conversion scale.
parameters.notes: Useful for miscalibrated rangefinder tests.

parameters.effect: Sets simulated rangefinder mounting orientation.
parameters.notes: Default 25 is downward-facing ROTATION_PITCH_270.

parameters.effect: Sets simulated battery resting voltage.
parameters.notes: For capacity-based sag, SIM_BATT_CAP_AH must be non-zero.

parameters.effect: Sets simulated battery capacity.
parameters.notes: 0 means unlimited capacity.

parameters.effect: Disables primary simulated barometer.
parameters.notes: Verify EKF altitude health and configured fallback response.

parameters.effect: Adds random noise to barometric height readings.
parameters.notes: Source units are height, not pressure.

parameters.effect: Applies barometric altitude drift over time.
parameters.notes: Source units are altitude drift rate.

parameters.effect: Adds a simulated barometric height glitch.
parameters.notes: Source units are height, not pressure.

parameters.effect: Freezes simulated barometer at the last recorded altitude.
parameters.notes: Useful for stuck sensor tests.

parameters.effect: Adds time delay to barometer data.
parameters.notes: Use for EKF delay sensitivity tests.

parameters.effect: Sets number of simulated barometer instances.
parameters.notes: Use for redundancy setup, usually before arming.

parameters.effect: Controls rate of gyroscope bias drift.
parameters.notes: Used with SIM_DRIFT_TIME.

parameters.effect: Sets duration of one full sinusoidal gyro drift cycle.
parameters.notes: Used with SIM_DRIFT_SPEED.

parameters.effect: Sets number of simulated IMU instances.
parameters.notes: Use for redundancy setup, usually before arming.

parameters.effect: Sets sinusoidal vibration frequency applied to IMU readings.
parameters.notes: Use with gyro and accel noise amplitudes.

parameters.effect: Sets max baseline frequency for throttle-linked motor vibration noise.
parameters.notes: Combined with motor/throttle state and gyro/accel noise factors.

stale_or_non_current_names.reason: Current Plane SITL exposes a gyro update failure mask, not SIM_GYR1_FAIL.
Current forced accelerometer failure value is SIM_ACCEL1_FAIL; update stoppage is SIM_ACC_FAIL_MSK.
Magnetometer noise is a global SITL parameter, not per-compass.
Current GPS simulation uses per-instance GPS1/GPS2/... ENABLE parameters.
Current GPS glitch vector is per-instance and uses GLTCH spelling.
Current GPS heading output is per-instance.
Current GPS satellite count is per-instance.
Current simulated GPS backend type is per-instance.
Current GPS noise parameter is per-instance.
Current GPS velocity error vector is per-instance.
Current GPS jamming control is per-instance.
